SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumGE1500 / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumGE1500 > 0.3 * T2.NumTstTakr;

SELECT MAX(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrRead >= 1500;

SELECT MAX(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath >= 1500;

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm f

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE (frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` * frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.3;
